gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-almendra: Almendra reads dignified and bookish, with a deep midsection in its lowercase that gives each line a settled look. And Plakkaat arrives above it, heavy and marker-drawn, its terminals curling nearly back to the stem.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-gf-bree-serif: Plakkaat is heavy, bent-straw lettering with curled terminals. It makes its mark in the big, blunt capitals, while Bree Serif, a text serif with outsized lowercase, does the quieter work of feeling literary and refined.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-outfit: Chunky, closed-up letters up top, then Outfit drawing open curves that stop short of closing, tall in the lowercase. Plakkaat feels packed and Outfit feels loose.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-plus-jakarta-sans: Plakkaat's terminals sweep around until they nearly touch the stem, giving its heavy capitals a bent-straw look. Plus Jakarta Sans answers with monoline strokes and curve endings kept well apart, so the sans feels open against those closed shapes.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-sora: Fat, bent-straw capitals with curled-in ends. Plakkaat does heavy and marker-like with ease, while Sora, a precise geometric sans of moderate lowercase height, keeps its c and s widely parted and quietly gets on with the reading.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-amulya: Amulya is a contemporary sans whose curves keep generous gaps, so it feels modern without crowding itself. Over a longer passage it goes down smoothly.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-chillax: Chillax reads casual and relaxed, its spaghetti-like lines leaving curves unfinished where the pen lifts. Tech-clean Quantum above it makes the pair feel crisp yet loose.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-plein: Plein reads reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Quantum is the tech-minded one, wiry and loosely spaced for display, while Plein is the sans built to carry the actual text.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-roundo: Quantum's letters look bent from a single wire, spaced loosely with mouths left open. Roundo follows in a plain sans manner, its n arch matching the stem and its small counters staying unclogged line after line.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans is contemporary and approachable, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Spline Sans sits easily under Quantum's wire-bent, loosely spaced tech lettering, its moderate lowercase giving that taller heading room to stand out.
